import { getAccessToken } from "/src/api/authSession.js";
import { RESEARCH_API_BASE, RvApiError, rwGet, rwPost } from "/src/features/research-workspace/api/client.ts";
export const COMPILE_IN_PROGRESS = "COMPILE_IN_PROGRESS";
export const COMPILE_IN_PROGRESS_MESSAGE = "正在编译中，请稍候…";
export function isCompileInProgress(err) {
  if (!err || typeof err !== "object") return false;
  return String(err.code) === COMPILE_IN_PROGRESS;
}
function toCompileRun(env) {
  const r = env?.compile_run;
  if (!r) return null;
  return {
    run_id: String(r.id),
    status: r.status,
    engine: r.engine,
    entry: r.entry,
    pdf_artifact_id: r.pdf_artifact_id ?? null,
    pdf_available: Boolean(r.pdf_available ?? r.pdf_artifact_id),
    last_successful_pdf_artifact_id: env?.last_successful_pdf_artifact_id ?? null,
    log_lines: r.log_lines ?? [],
    duration_ms: r.duration_ms ?? null,
    page_count: r.page_count ?? null,
    pdf_size_bytes: r.pdf_size_bytes ?? null,
    error_count: r.error_count ?? 0,
    warning_count: r.warning_count ?? 0,
    error_code: r.error_code ?? "",
    error_message: r.error_message ?? ""
  };
}
export async function compile(projectId, entry = "main.tex", engine = "xelatex", signal) {
  try {
    const env = await rwPost(
      `/projects/${projectId}/compile`,
      { engine, entry },
      void 0,
      { signal }
    );
    return toCompileRun(env);
  } catch (e) {
    if (isCompileInProgress(e)) {
      throw new RvApiError({
        code: COMPILE_IN_PROGRESS,
        status: 409,
        message: COMPILE_IN_PROGRESS_MESSAGE,
        retryable: true
      });
    }
    throw e;
  }
}
export async function compileRun(projectId, runId) {
  const env = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/compile-runs/${runId}`);
  return toCompileRun(env);
}
export async function latestRun(projectId) {
  const env = await rwGet(`/projects/${projectId}/compile-runs/latest`);
  return toCompileRun(env);
}
export async function downloadRunPdf(projectId, runId) {
  const url = `${RESEARCH_API_BASE}/projects/${projectId}/compile-runs/${encodeURIComponent(runId)}/pdf`;
  const headers = { Accept: "application/pdf" };
  const token = getAccessToken();
  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers, credentials: "include" });
  if (!res.ok) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error("PDF 暂不可用"), { status: res.status, code: res.status });
  }
  const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();
  return new Uint8Array(buf);
}
